verdict.rationale: Activepieces keeps edits in a draft that does not affect the published flow until you click Publish, and Sensitive projects add an approval gate before publishing. Its MCP server can also "test automations." None of this shows an isolated sandbox: draft tests may still run against live connected apps and real data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or staging environment, test or mock connections or data isolated from production, documentation of how test runs avoid touching live systems, and independent corroboration.
